title: Import an account statement while skipping its trailing summary rows
steps: Change `Skip end lines` from 0 to 2 in the configured CSV import.

video_guide.summary: Watch the import mappings and transaction preview when Skip end lines becomes 2. The footer disappears, but the existing date and amount settings reset.

chapters.note: Three transactions and two summary rows are shown with the configured mappings and Flip amount selected.
The summary rows are removed, but Date becomes Choose field and the remaining dates become invalid.
Amount now uses Posting, the date format has reset, and Flip amount is unchecked.
